blocks.text: You can enable, disable, edit, delete, or update the rule priority of an action rule as required.

blocks.item: Enabling or Disabling an Action Rule
From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > DSPM > Action Rules.
On the Action Rules page, click the toggle under the Status column to enable or disable the action rule.
See image.
A message appears indicating that the action rule has been updated successfully.
See image.
An action rule is disabled in the following scenarios:
All resources for the selected scope are deleted.
The selected label is deleted from Microsoft Purview Information Protection.
See image.
Invalid rules retain their assigned priority. Deleting an invalid rule is necessary to make its specific priority level available for a new valid action rule.
Editing an Action Rule
From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > DSPM > Action Rules.
On the Action Rules page, click the Actions icon () and select Edit for the required action rule.
See image.
The Edit Action Rule page appears.
On the Edit Action Rule page, in the General Information section, change the Rule Name, Rule Priority, or Rule Description as required, then click Next.
See image.
In the Configuration section, update the filters as required.
See image.
Click Save Changes.
A message appears indicating that the action rule is updated successfully.
Deleting an Action Rule
From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > DSPM > Action Rules.
On the Action Rules page, click the Actions icon () and select Delete for the required action rule.
See image.
A confirmation message appears. Enter CONFIRM in the field and click Delete.
See image.
A message appears indicating that the action rule is updated successfully.
Updating the Priority of an Action Rule
From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > DSPM > Action Rules.
On the Action Rules page, click the Actions icon () and select Update Rule Priority for the required action rule.
See image.
The Update Rule Priority window appears.
Change the Rule Priority as required.
See image.
Click Update Priority.
A message appears indicating that the priority is updated successfully.
